      "observations": [
        "All 44 eligible owned test paths and all 1,681 historical diff lines were read after product/conditional preflight. The patch replaces 172 noncomputed BrowserTestUtils.waitForCondition receivers with TestUtils.waitForCondition. An Acorn comparison of all 44 before/after programs, excluding source positions and raw literal spelling, finds no other executable AST changes after that exact receiver normalization. This is source identity for predicates, arguments and surrounding statements; it does not prove that the two upstream APIs have the same behavior.",
        "The source preserves several caller contracts. getAddonElement returns the wait promise and its caller passes the awaited value to addon-card DOM helpers. isExtensionLocked queries buttons on the awaited addon-card. The account-hub test calls getIndexForUID on the awaited books element. These call sites depend on the wait result value, not only completion. The spaces-toolbar, compose-notification, attachment and recipient-pill tests also retain promises created before their actions and await those same promises afterward.",
        "The historical Calendar test defines isUnifinderHidden to return true for a non-Calendar tab or a hidden bottom-events-box. Its post-toggle wait polls that positive hidden condition while the message says “calendar unifinder should have opened”. That is a static predicate/message mismatch retained by this callee-only port. The fixed accepted test separately waits for the Calendar tab and then polls !unifinderBox.hidden. No timeout, failure or cure was reproduced, and the later correction is not credited to this original port.",
        "No assertion API or assertion argument changes are introduced by the executable AST comparison. Wait failure strings are wait arguments, not assertion-message arguments. Existing async tasks, custom DOM receivers, pref state, guards, callback bodies, action order and cleanup remain in their original file roles. Mechanical wrapping changes do not establish a new formatting or test convention.",
        "The replacement names are test-harness globals. No paired Gecko BrowserTestUtils/TestUtils implementation or upstream Bug 1710902 body was inspected. Polling frequency, timeout, rejection, promise-result and async-predicate behavior remain bounded harness dependencies. Static caller requirements are recorded without claiming that this port executed successfully or that a helper implementation satisfies them.",
        "Required primary Bug 2048777 and own review D307670 inherit complete retained collector coverage from Root and C3 with exact original records, scopes, timestamps and digests. A read the exact sparse status/landing discussion needed for this port, without another browser read or a second independent full-body confirmation.",
        "D307670 has no actual inlines or summary/test-plan histories. Its creation-to-final timeline explicitly says it landed in Needs Review without acceptance and with ongoing or failed builds. The bustage-fix metadata and later beta/release mentions do not establish reviewer approval, a successful test run or helper equivalence. There is no implementation suggestion to infer from silence.",
        "The primary has an empty description, the review attachment/landing comments and FIXED → ASSIGNED → FIXED activity. It links upstream Bug 1710902, whose body and paired helper implementation remain unread. Actual comm source establishes the 172 receiver changes, retained caller contracts and the separately later accepted Unifinder condition."
